home.title: Overview
home.content:
# Persona 3 Reload

A ground-up remake of the 2006 original. This document is the *minimum* shape a content file can have: one `home` page plus metadata.

## Editors' note

Keep page bodies under ~50 KB each. The runtime fetches exactly one file per page, so a fat page only ever costs the reader who opens it — but a fat page still costs that reader everything.

social-links.title: Social Links
social-links.content:
## Priority order for a first run

1. **Fool** — automatic
2. **Magician** (Kenji) — early access to strong fusion fodder
3. **Hierophant** (Bunkichi) — cheap stat gains
4. **Priestess** (Fuuka) — support skills that scale into the late game

> Missing a Social Link is normal. The schedule is generous after the summer.
